commandId.description: The client-generated UUID every command takes; a retry with the same id applies once.

connectionId.description: A key-manager connection's id: a version 4 UUID the adding client mints, kept in lowercase.

address.description: The new address: only its origin is kept.

ca.description: The CA to pin from now on, which a person accepted; null to pin none. OpenBao only.

anyOf.description: The CA certificate a connection pins, as PEM (one or more certificates, up to 65536 characters): every request to the key manager verifies its certificate against it, and trusts nothing else.

tokenRole.description: The token role from now on; null for none. OpenBao only.

anyOf.description: The token role run tokens are created against: no slash, on one line.
